parameters.name: Config
parameters.description: The configuration of the media fingerprint library, specified as a JSON-formatted string. Leave this parameter empty for default settings.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the media fingerprint library.

parameters.name: ModelId
parameters.description:
The model ID of the media fingerprint library.

- The model ID for a text media fingerprint library is **11** (deprecated).

- The model ID for a video media fingerprint library is **12**.

- The model ID for an audio media fingerprint library is **13**.

- The model ID for an image media fingerprint library is **14** (deprecated).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the media fingerprint library.
